question: Why are Vaishnavas unfit in Kula Kali procedure?
premises: it is said in Kula Kali procedure
those devoted to ash lack fitness
inference: Vaishnava ash-devotion does not fit Kula Kali procedure.
plain_english: In Kula Kali procedure it is indeed said: especially Vaishnavas, and those devoted to ash and so on, have no fitness.
